default.notes: All nationalities need a visa: obtain a letter of invitation approved by the State Migration Service through a licensed tour operator, then apply at an embassy or collect the visa on arrival with the approved letter.

TM.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Turkmen citizens.

RU.notes: Despite CIS ties, Russian citizens need a visa with an approved letter of invitation like everyone else — Turkmenistan withdrew from CIS visa-free arrangements in 1999.

UZ.notes: A visa with an approved invitation letter is required; limited exemptions exist only for residents of designated border districts on short local visits.

KZ.notes: A visa with an approved invitation letter is required; limited exemptions exist only for residents of designated border districts on short local visits.
